Indian MMA semi-finalist Suchika lost the Gold Medal bcz of 700 Gms. 💔 

- Indian MMA semi-finalist Suchika has refused to accept the result against Singapore’s Tiffany Teo
- Regulation time ended in a draw
- The one-minute overtime was first given 2-1 to Teo
- India protested and arbitration later called the bout a tie
- Under the rules, a tie goes to the lighter athlete
- Suchika was about 700 grams heavier, so Singapore went through to the final
- That is a brutal way to miss a gold-medal fight
- She was still standing with Teo. The scales made the decision for her.
